The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. I made the change in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, with the same `ORDER BY` as the sales-rep method. The region-related tests pass (RegionManagerTest, RegionReportTest, SupportTicketTest: 13 tests, 0 failures). Nothing is committed.

Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded, as before. I didn't add a test for the T-1…T-5 example, so the ordering is verified only by reading the SQL.
